avatar.description: URL of the athlete's profile picture.
URL of the athlete's profile picture.

details.description: Only the details this viewer may see: public ones, plus mutuals-only ones for a mutual and everything for the athlete themselves.

following.description: URI of the viewer's follow record, if any.

details.description: Optional athlete details. Each is stored in the public profile record only when the athlete makes it public; otherwise it lives in the athlete's app.activitytracker.space.athlete space for its visibility (see actor.privateDetails).

gender.description: A known value, or the athlete's own description.

training.description: The athlete's training thresholds, and the models their heart rate and power zones are derived from.

thresholdHeartRate.description: Lactate threshold heart rate, beats per minute.

heartRateZoneModel.description: How heart rate zones are derived from the thresholds.

powerZoneModel.description: How power zones are derived from functionalThresholdPower.

autoUpdate.description: The thresholds that imported activities may update from the recording device's settings.

sports.description: Per-sport overrides, at most one per sport. The fields above are the defaults: an activity of a sport listed here uses that entry's values where it sets them, and the defaults otherwise.

history.description: Every value the thresholds (the defaults' and each sport's) have had, kept for the athlete to look back on. The newest entry for a threshold is its current value, unless the athlete has cleared it since. Shares the training's visibility.

thresholdEntry.description: A value a threshold took, when it took effect and where it came from.

threshold.description: The threshold, named as its field in #training or #sportTraining.

sport.description: The sport whose override (#sportTraining) took the value, or absent for the defaults.

value.description: In the threshold's own unit and range, as its field in #training or #sportTraining has them: watts, beats per minute, or millimeters per second for thresholdSpeed.

setAt.description: When the value took effect: when the athlete set it, or the start of the activity it was read from. Absent when unknown, for a value saved before history was kept.

source.description: Where the value came from: entered by the athlete, read from a recording device's settings in an imported activity, or synced from a service. Absent when unknown.

device.description: The recording device, such as 'Garmin Edge 840', for a value from a device.

sportTraining.description: Thresholds and zone models for one sport, overriding the defaults in #training. Resting heart rate is not per sport.

sport.description: The sport of an app.activitytracker.feed.activity record.

functionalThresholdPower.description: Threshold power for this sport, in watts.

thresholdHeartRate.description: Lactate threshold heart rate, beats per minute.

thresholdSpeed.description: Threshold speed, millimeters per second (lexicons have no floats). Clients show it as a pace.

speedZoneModel.description: How speed zones are derived from thresholdSpeed.

setAt.description: When each of this sport's thresholds took effect.

trainingSetAt.description: When each threshold took effect: when the athlete set it, or the start of the activity it was read from. An import only updates a threshold from an activity that started later.

visibility.description: Who may see a detail: anyone, accounts the athlete and the viewer both follow, or only the athlete.
